title: Type size anchors and bounds
why: Size carries volume. If the baseline drifts, every caption in the title is the wrong size relative to the frame; if the bounds drift, a shout and a whisper stop being distinguishable from ordinary speech.

cases.note: 2.3.5: baseline for normal speaking volume is 5% of frame height.
No measurement available must fall back to the baseline, never to zero.
2.3.6: smallest type size is 3% of frame height.
2.3.6: largest type size is 12% of frame height.
